entries: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 2-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

items.name: Age:
entries: Average life span 70-90 years.

items.name: Language
entries: You speak manish which is spanish.

entries.name: Resourceful
entries: You gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Skillful
entries: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

entries.name: Versatile
entries: You gain an {@filter Origin feat|feats|category=o} of your choice.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 4-5 feet tall)

items.name: Age:
entries: Average life span 110-130 years.

items.name: Language
entries: You speak dwarvish which is german.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison damage. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries: Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

entries.name: Stonecunning
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you gain {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB}. The stone can be natural or worked.

You can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 5-6 feet tall)

items.name: Age:
entries: Average life span 250-280 years.

items.name: Language
entries: You speak elvish which is french.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Elven Lineage
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait.

entries.caption: Elven Lineages
rows: You know the {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} cantrip. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace that cantrip with a different {@filter cantrip from the Wizard spell list|spells|level=0|class=Wizard}.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Insight|XPHB}, {@skill Perception|XPHB}, or {@skill Survival|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Trance
entries: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

items.name: Elven Lineage (High Elf)
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. You know the {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} cantrip. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace that cantrip with a different {@filter cantrip from the Wizard spell list|spells|level=0|class=Wizard}.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Small (about 2-3 feet tall)

items.name: Age:
entries: Average life span 60-80 years.

items.name: Language
entries: You speak halfling which is russian.

entries.name: Brave
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Halfling Nimbleness
entries: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space.

entries.name: Luck
entries: When you roll a 1 on the {@dice d20} of a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

entries.name: Naturally Stealthy
entries: You can take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

items.name: Age:
entries: Average life span 40-60 years.

items.name: Language
entries: You speak gnomish which is greek.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Gnomish Cunning
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

entries.name: Gnomish Lineage
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you gain the trait):

items.name: Forest Gnome
entries: You know the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} cantrip. You also always have the {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

items.name: Gnomish Lineage (Forest Gnome)
entries: You know the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} cantrip. You also always have the {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 6-7 feet tall)

items.name: Age:
entries: Average life span 90-110 years.

items.name: Language
entries: You speak orcish which is japanese.

entries.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: You can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When you do so, you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclass.name: Path of the Dune Wanderer
subclassFeatures: Path of the Dune Wanderer|Barbarian|XPHB|Dune Wanderer|AGtM|3

subclassFeature.name: Path of the Dune Wanderer
entries: {@i Rage like the Desert Storm}

Barbarians who walk the Path of the Dune Wanderer live on the edge of civilization and the endless dunes. You have learned to survive the harshest of the desert. Your rage channels the violence of the dunes.

entries.subclassFeature: Rage of the Desert Storm|Barbarian|XPHB|Dune Wanderer|AGtM|3

subclassFeature.name: Resilience of the Dunes
entries: You have learned to survive on the worst of conditions. You only ever need to consume food and water for a tiny sized creature no matter your size.

subclassFeature.name: Rage of the Desert Storm
entries: While your rage is active you gain a blindsight up to 30 feet. A sandstorm gathers around you any creature within a 30 feet emanation from you must succeed a con save DC 8 + prof + con mod and on a fail is {@condition blinded}.

subclassFeature.name: Shifting Sands
entries: While you are raging you move with the sand. You can reduce all damage you take by your strength modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Speed of the Sands
entries: Whenever you take damage while raging you can use your reaction to teleport anywhere within your sandstorm.

subclassFeature.name: Rage of the Sandstorm
entries: Your sandstorm increases to 60 feet now whenever a creature fails the con save they take an amount of d6's equal to your rage damage.

subclassFeature.name: College of Assassins
entries: {@i The not so silent death}
Bards of College of Assassins use the fact that they are welcome near many people of power to remove obstacles to their goals or remove enemies of the highest bidder.

subclassFeature.name: Distracted Death
entries: Gain proficiency with poisoners kit. You add your charisma modifier to sleight of hand rolls. As a bonus action you can roll a deception or performance check against a creatures insight if you succeed on the creature you gain advantage on that creature for the next minute or until you use this feature again.

subclassFeature.name: Killing Blow
entries: If you have advantage on an attack roll and roll a sleight of hand above the targets AC you can roll your Bardic die twice and add it to the damage.

subclassFeature.name: Silent Casting
entries: When you cast a spell you can expend a use of your bardic to ignore all components for the spell or you can cast that spell as a bonus action. If the spell has an attack roll you add the bardic die to the attack roll. If the spell has a saving throw and targets a single creature you can subtract a roll of the bardic die from the roll.

subclassFeature.name: Bardic Poison
entries: On your turn as a bonus action you can expend a bardic inspiration die to coat your blade or ammunition in poison. A creature that takes Piercing or Slashing damage from the poisoned weapon or ammunition takes an extra four rolls of your bardic die as poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.

subclassFeature.name: Order of Fallindriea
entries: {@i The mistress of magic has blessed you}
The magic domain focuses on the Arcane and the mysteries of the goddess of magic. Clerics who tap into this domain wield magic in a new way.

subclassFeature.name: Magic Domain Spells
entries: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Life Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Magic Domain Spells
rows: {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB}, {@spell Mirror Missile|XPHB}, {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Mistress of Magic
entries: Your goddess lets you alter your magic as you cast it. Whenever you cast a spell you can choose to.
Alter Elements If the spell deals Fire, Poison, Lightning, Thunder, Force, Radiant, Necrotic, Acid, Psychic, or Poison damage you can change the type to any of those.
Alter Save You can change the type of save the creature must make for the spell.
Save the faithful You can choose up to wisdom mod creatures to automatically succeed the saving throw.

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divine Mage
entries: As a magic action you present your holy symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to cast a spell. When you cast a spell in this way it is upcast to your highest spell slot.

subclassFeature.name: Holy Speed
entries: When you cast a spell you can use a bonus action to cast a cantrip.

subclassFeature.name: Divine Concentration
entries: Your goddess has expanded your mind. You are able to concentrate on wisdom modifier (min 1) spells at once. You only ever roll concentration for one spell at time.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Death
entries: {@i You become death destroyer of worlds}
Druids of the Circle of Death draw on the lifeforce of others to power their magic.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Death Spells
entries: When you reach a Druid level specified in the Circle of Death Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Circle of Death Spells
rows: {@spell Toll the Dead|XPHB}, {@spell False Life|XPHB}, {@spell Inflict Wounds|XPHB}, {@spell Gentle Repose|XPHB}, {@spell Ray of Enfeeblement|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: Shape of Death
entries: As a magic action, you can expend a use of your wild shape and bring death upon those near to you. Choose up to wisdom modifier creatures within 60 feet of you they must make a wisdom saving throw against your spell save. On a failure taking necrotic damage equal to a roll of D6's equal to half your druid level. On a success taking half damage. You also gain temporary hit points equal to the damage rolled.

subclassFeature.name: Friend of Death
entries: You add your wisdom modifier to constitution saves and also to death saves.

subclassFeature.name: Dead Men Tell no Tales
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of you drops to 0 hit points you can use a reaction to regain a use of wild shape. You can use this feature wisdom modifier (min 1), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: The Dead no Longer Sleep
entries: You are immune to necrotic damage. As a magic action, you summon forth remains of the fallen from the earth choose 2d6 creatures within 120 feet they must make a wisdom save against your spell save. On a failure they take 5d8 necrotic damage and 5d8 bludgeoning and have the restrained condition for the next minute. They can use their action to repeat this save on their turn. On a success they only take half damage. You can use this feature proficiency bonus amount of times, you regain all uses of this feature after finishing a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Doom Fighter
entries: {@i You doom all who dare to fight you}

Doom Fighters are known for being relentless pursuers and the are able to extend fights beyond most creatures abilities to survive. They are said to be imbued with some force of relentless power and endless vengeance.

subclassFeature.name: Extended Fighting
entries: When hit by an enemy while bloodied you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. When using second wind gain 2d6 temp HP.

subclassFeature.name: Dooming Blade
entries: Any blade wielded by a doom fighter becomes dooming in itself. A Doom blade on hit against a enemy at less than full HP gains 1d4 necrotic damage. A doom blade hit against a enemy at half health deals 1d6 necrotic damage. The amount of damage die is doubled if the Doom fighter is under bloodied.

subclassFeature.name: Dooming Slow
entries: Escaping a doom fighter is near impossible. Any damage dealt by a doom fighter inflicts a slow of 10 feet until the end of their next turn. An enemy hit by an opportunity attack from a doom fighter has their speed set to 0 and must make a CON save of 8 + proficiency bonus + CON modifier. If failed the enemy takes 2d6 necrotic damage and the fighter heals for 2d4 hit-points. On a success the enemy takes half damage and the fighter gains 1d6 temp hp.

subclassFeature.name: Doomed Fight
entries: When you deal necrotic damage you heal for half the damage dealt.

subclassFeature.name: Mark of Doom
entries: An enemy hit by a Dooming blade becomes Doomed. A doomed enemy must attack the Doom fighter who doomed it on its turn. If the Doomed does not attack the fighter it must make a WIS save DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + CON modifier. If failed the Doomed takes 6d12 necrotic damage. On a success it takes half damage.

subclassFeature.name: Doomsday
entries: Using your action trigger Doomsday. Every doomed creature must make a CON save of DC 14 + proficiency bonus + CON modifier. On a successful save the creature takes 10d12 necrotic damage. On a failed save the creature is set to 1 HP. This feature can be used CON modifier (Minimum 1) times before needing a long rest to restore charges.

subclassFeature.name: Warrior of Stone Fists
entries: {@i You have fists of stone}
The warrior of stone fists spend years in the mountains honing their fists against the stone carving themselves to become one with the rock.

subclassFeature.name: Fists of Stone
entries: Whenever you hit a creature with a unarmed strike if the creature is large or smaller you can push them back 10 feet. When you hit a creature with a strike from your flurry of blows you can force them to roll a strength save equal to your focus point save. On a failure the creature falls prone and has the restrained condition until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Skin of Stone
entries: Your skin has been hardened by years of training. You gain an AC bonus equal to your constitution modifier (minimum 1). On your turn you can use a bonus action to expend 2 focus points to become resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for 1 minute.

subclassFeature.name: Stature of Stone
entries: You can not be moved against your will by any means. You cannot fly by any non-magical means and when falling the moment you hit the ground any creature within five feet takes half your falling damage.

subclassFeature.name: Sense of Stone
entries: You have tremor sense of 30 feet and you can spend a focus point to extend the range to 120 feet for 10 minutes.

subclassFeature.name: Shifting Stone
entries: You are able to mold the stone around you. As a reaction you can make any ten feet cube within 30 feet into difficult terrain. As a bonus action on your turn any creature within the area must succeed a dexterity save DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Wisdom Mod, on a fail their speed is set to 0 feet and take disadvantage on all attacks rolls. On success they are slowed by 20 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Fist of Magma
entries: Your fist of stone become super heated add two martial arts die as fire damage. Any creature hit burns taking two rolls of your martial arts die as fire damage at the start of their next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of Mercy
entries: {@i All creatures deserve your mecry}
The Oath of Mercy binds Paladins to the ideals of kindness and mercy. They seek to end the suffering of others at any cost.
These paladins share the following tenets:

items: Show the sick and injured the mercy of a quick death
Cease senseless violence even if requiring greater violence
All creatures no matter what deserve mercy

subclassFeature.name: Oath of Mercy Spells
entries: The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Vengeance Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeature.name: A Quick Death
entries: When you take the attack action against a creature that is poisoned or bloodied, you can expend one use of your channel divinity to usher them to the next life. The creature takes extra necrotic or radiant damage equal to 3 times their paladin level.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Peace
entries: Anyone within your aura is immune to the frightened condition. If a frightened creature enters your aura they take charisma modifier radiant or necrotic damage.

subclassFeature.name: Expedited Mercy
entries: When you hit a creature that is poisoned or bloodied, you can use your bonus action to force the creature to make a constitution save against your spell save. On a failure the creature instantly falls to one hit point. On a success the creature takes an extra 4d6 radiant or necrotic damage. You can use this feature charisma modifier times (min 1), you regain all uses of this feature after a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: The Ultimate Mercy
entries: If you have no uses of expedited mercy at the start of combat you regain all expended uses. The damage the creature takes on a success becomes 8d6 radiant or necrotic.

subclassFeature.name: Flames Walker
entries: {@i You walk through the flames}
You have walked through the flames and been purified by fire. You wield the magic of fire and walk through the flames.

subclassFeature.name: Flames Walker Spells
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Flames Walker Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Walk Through Flames
entries: You are resistant to fire damage.

Fire Strike When you attack a creature and hit it with a weapon, you can deal an extra 2d6 Fire damage. You can use this benefit only once per turn, you can use it a number or times equal to your wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

subclassFeature.name: Flame Step
entries: On your turn as a bonus action you can teleport 30 feet. You can use this feature wisdom modifier (minimum of one), you regain all uses of this feature on a Long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Flames Mark
entries: The damage from your hunter's mark becomes 1d8 fire damage. A creature effected by your hunter's mark loses resistance to fire damage, immunity to fire damage becomes resistance.

subclassFeature.name: Wildfire Step
entries: The range of your flame step becomes 60 feet, and any creature within 10 feet of where you appear takes your druid level as fire damage.

subclassFeature.name: Street Fighter Rogue
entries: {@i You fight among the streets}
You have been trained to excel at fighting fast, dirty, and sly.

subclassFeature.name: Sly Fighter
entries: You can use Dexterity instead of strength for unarmed strikes. You can make a unarmed attack as a bonus action. You roll half your sneak attack damage in place of unarmed strike damage. You can use sneak attack on a unarmed strike.

subclassFeature.name: Slick Moves
entries: After making an attack you can use your reaction to move half your move speed. When making this move you don’t provoke opportunity attacks and you can move through enemy space without costing more feet of movement.

subclassFeature.name: Fast Fighter
entries: Once per turn after making an attack make a sleight of hand check versus the enemies perception. If the check succeeds make another attack.

subclassFeature.name: Flurry of Knives
entries: When you make an attack using a light weapon you attack twice instead of once.

subclassFeature.name: Double Sneak Attack
entries: You can use sneak attack twice per turn.

subclassFeature.name: Primordial Sorcerer
entries: {@i The blood of the Primordials flows through you}
Your spark of magic comes from the primordial Artifex themselves.

subclassFeature.name: Primordial Casting
entries: When you take this feature you can learn a spell from any spell list. Whenever you finish a long rest you can replace this spell with a different one.

subclassFeature.name: Shape the World
entries: When a cast a spell you can ignore all components for that spell. You can use this feature once before needing to take a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: The Primordial Word
entries: Whenever you spend a sorcery point you gain Sorcerer level of temp hp.

subclassFeature.name: Primordial Counter Spell
entries: You can cast counter spell using sorcery points.

subclassFeature.name: Primordial Magic
entries: Whenever you cast a spell under level 5 you can expend a sorcery point to regain that spell slot.

subclassFeature.name: Pact of the World
entries: {@i Your magic is from the world itself}
Your pact draws on the very power of the world itself. You have made a promise to the essence of the world itself.

subclassFeature.name: World Spells
entries: The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the World Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: World Spells
rows: {@spell Guidance|XPHB}, {@spell Create or Destroy Water|XPHB}, {@spell Entangle|XPHB}, {@spell Barkskin|XPHB}, {@spell Heat Metal|XPHB}

subclassFeature.name: One with Stone
entries: You have advantage on effects that would restrict your movement.

subclassFeature.name: One with Plants
entries: You always have speak with plants prepared and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain this use on a long and short rest. You can never get lost by non-magical means.

subclassFeature.name: The World is With You
entries: You any temp HP you gain is doubled. Whenever you lose all of your temp HP you can use your reaction to heal for Warlock level + Charisma modifier hit points.

subclassFeature.name: One with The World
entries: People can feel your innate connection with the world. You can choose to gain expertise in two skills and you gain proficiency in four skills of your choice.

subclassFeature.name: School of Fieldcraft
entries: {@i You learn by doing}
School of Fieldcraft Wizards study their magic in the wilderness and tend to have a less disciplined approach to magic.

subclassFeature.name: Survival Expert
entries: Gain proficiency with survival. Gain expertise in survival.

subclassFeature.name: Right Answer Wrong Formula
entries: Whenever casting a spell you can take disadvantage on the attack roll or give a creature advantage on a saving throw. This doubles the spells damage die. So 2d6 becomes 4d6.

subclassFeature.name: Natural Power
entries: Counter spell and dispel magic become cantrips. On a fail take 3d4 force damage.

subclassFeature.name: Arcane Craze
entries: As a reaction enter an arcane craze. Arcane Craze lasts 1 minute. You become weak to all damage. You have disadvantage on saving throws and enemies have advantage on all attack rolls. When in Arcane Craze use your action to have each creature you choose within 60 feet roll an INT save. On a save taking 6d6 force damage. On a fail taking half damage. Using your bonus action make an attack roll against up to 6 targets on a hit dealing 4d8 force damage. Using your reaction force a creature to make a DC 5 INT Save. On a fail taking 1d100 force damage. On a save taking 4 force damage. You can use Arcan Craze intelligence modifier times (minimum of one), you regain all expended uses on a long rest.

subclassFeature.name: Rough Training
entries: Whenever you cast a spell gain 4d6 + INT modifier temp HP. Gain INT Modifier * Wizard LVL max HP.
